tools.method_scope_and_difference: No top-level upstream license located in the reviewed tree; use only an owned checkout with actual permitted-use evidence. No author code is redistributed.
Academia limited non-profit edition only; Enterprise excluded. Native binary and its actual license must already be provisioned by owner.
Offline molecular-formula/fragmentation-tree route only; no fingerprint/structure prediction service is called.
Actual author-result import implemented. Fresh proprietary online prediction remains outside current authorization; no private spectra upload, no claim of an offline CSI algorithm.
Actual original legacy Python spectral alignment plus explicit mutual-top-K. This is not the complete GNPS2 FBMN workflow or a structure identification method; no upload.
Owner-provisioned licensed DOCKovalent 3.7 plus actual prepared DB2/grids. Not DOCK 3.8 or ordinary Vina. No licensed engine bundled.

Correct biomap-research/MorphDiff source, separate five-channel gene-to-image and image-to-image. The pinned native DDIM sampler forces CUDA; an existing server GPU is required, CPU is rejected. Not bowang-lab/MorphoDiff; generated morphology is not measured microscopy.
Native Gaussian PGM inference with actual fixed drug/dose embeddings; no new training, no fabricated chemical embedding or independent-validation claim.

EperLuo/scDiffusion latent DDPM/DDIM plus strict autoencoder decode; empty, one- or two-classifier guidance with exact class and noise-schedule binding. Generated class-conditioned expression is not a perturbation effect; gradient interpolation from a real starting cell is a separate unimplemented scope.

Native semantic encoder and DDIM with training-only frozen latent direction. Upstream license file contains unresolved merge markers; actual owned-use review required. No fake get_diffused_data noise helper.
Native finite-tuned driver logits/ranks using exact vocabulary, graph and actual training class prefix. Not expression prediction, calibrated probability or causal driver confirmation.
Native StateICL in-context count prediction. Code and model/output licenses differ; no full-object pickle, missing-gene zero padding or context/target-unit leakage.
